title: Lipshitz Sequence
statementMd:
A function ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f07df5c4af1af0378cc7859607253a89e341f3b.png) is called Lipschitz continuous if there is a real constant $*K*$ such that the inequality $|*f*(*x*) - *f*(*y*)| ≤ *K*·|*x* - *y*|$ holds for all ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38cf78ee7e5e196f47739d8e2f90ad8196eef553.png). We'll deal with a more... discrete version of this term.

For an array ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff64cafd17d3b049f6048c69500dfcb615d3f375.png), we define it's Lipschitz constant ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/539010632b4d4ca811bfa977e7820e3abe5f2fae.png) as follows:

- if $*n* < 2$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4408c649f3ff72675e50b77c47abde2338612a63.png)
- if $*n* ≥ 2$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/96a21f7d56a33aed6c08988a969895ed2788f932.png) over all $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *n*$

In other words, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dc5c983dd5ec31fcb548359077409fdc9f959ad1.png) is the smallest non-negative integer such that $|*h*[*i*] - *h*[*j*]| ≤ *L*·|*i* - *j*|$ holds for all $1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ *n*$.

You are given an array ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/515376bdf4e0cb52e5c7435e579cb212490e9db2.png) of size $*n*$ and $*q*$ queries of the form $[*l*, *r*]$. For each query, consider the subarray ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c884fec5726a1dc470ccf9dcdbdb93e48641ba63.png); determine the sum of Lipschitz constants of **all subarrays** of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/63c2fec5ac52e647308cdc25e4089eaabd2d4bea.png).

## Input

The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$ and $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$) — the number of elements in array ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/515376bdf4e0cb52e5c7435e579cb212490e9db2.png) and the number of queries respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/870bb36b2ac35fdc7e1ba3db60a75eaf804c5d2d.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25f4eda9373a97ed7c6fd3cfd5fe1e70baccdf01.png)).

The following $*q*$ lines describe queries. The $*i*$-th of those lines contains two space-separated integers $*l*_{*i*}$ and $*r*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Print the answers to all queries in the order in which they are given in the input. For the $*i*$-th query, print one line containing a single integer — the sum of Lipschitz constants of all subarrays of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7436332d0ff76523fd4bdfcfd4cbc42df6b75dac.png).

## Note

In the first query of the first sample, the Lipschitz constants of subarrays of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddadffaf9e222576b1abb771dcd83dbad588d7fe.png) with length at least $2$ are:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/887651f76ac57b8f2b2dbd46c6ac2335ac2a270a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9eed4a49028e9bd234162d9da74fd4f86481378.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16eff35d7bd22d3e34c55fc95cc6c59212d5b1c8.png)

The answer to the query is their sum.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
函数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f07df5c4af1af0378cc7859607253a89e341f3b.png) 被称为 Lipschitz 连续函数，当且仅当存在实数常量 $*K*$，使得对于所有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38cf78ee7e5e196f47739d8e2f90ad8196eef553.png)，不等式 $|*f*(*x*) - *f*(*y*)| ≤ *K*·|*x* - *y*|$ 恒成立。我们将研究这一概念的一个更加……离散的版本。

对于一个数组 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff64cafd17d3b049f6048c69500dfcb615d3f375.png)，我们定义它的 Lipschitz 常数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/539010632b4d4ca811bfa977e7820e3abe5f2fae.png) 如下：

- 如果 $*n* < 2$，则 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4408c649f3ff72675e50b77c47abde2338612a63.png)
- 如果 $*n* ≥ 2$，则为对所有 $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *n*$ 取 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/96a21f7d56a33aed6c08988a969895ed2788f932.png) 的结果

换句话说，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dc5c983dd5ec31fcb548359077409fdc9f959ad1.png) 是满足对于所有 $1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ *n*$ 都有 $|*h*[*i*] - *h*[*j*]| ≤ *L*·|*i* - *j*|$ 的最小非负整数。

给定一个长度为 $*n*$ 的数组 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/515376bdf4e0cb52e5c7435e579cb212490e9db2.png)，以及 $*q*$ 个形如 $[*l*, *r*]$ 的询问。对于每个询问，考虑子数组 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c884fec5726a1dc470ccf9dcdbdb93e48641ba63.png)；求 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/63c2fec5ac52e647308cdc25e4089eaabd2d4bea.png) 的**所有子数组**的 Lipschitz 常数之和。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$），分别表示数组 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/515376bdf4e0cb52e5c7435e579cb212490e9db2.png) 的元素个数和询问数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个由空格分隔的整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/870bb36b2ac35fdc7e1ba3db60a75eaf804c5d2d.png)（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25f4eda9373a97ed7c6fd3cfd5fe1e70baccdf01.png)）。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行描述询问。其中第 $*i*$ 行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*l*_{*i*}$ 和 $*r*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

按照输入中给出的顺序输出所有询问的答案。对于第 $*i*$ 个询问，输出一行一个整数，表示 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7436332d0ff76523fd4bdfcfd4cbc42df6b75dac.png) 的所有子数组的 Lipschitz 常数之和。

## 说明

在第一个样例的第一个询问中，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddadffaf9e222576b1abb771dcd83dbad588d7fe.png) 的长度至少为 $2$ 的子数组的 Lipschitz 常数如下：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/887651f76ac57b8f2b2dbd46c6ac2335ac2a270a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9eed4a49028e9bd234162d9da74fd4f86481378.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16eff35d7bd22d3e34c55fc95cc6c59212d5b1c8.png)

该询问的答案就是它们的和。
</statement>
